t: An Auction Of The Property Of The Deceased Chen Chi Mei

pages.en:
Form 2    84
Shanghai Municipal Police.
C. I. D.
I. O. REG                                Central Police                Station.
No. 578
Date 18. 9. 16                           September 15th,       1916.

REPORT ON    An Auction of the property of the deceased Chen Chi Mei.
or of some other members of his Revolutionary Party.

Made by    D.S.I.Brewster.            Forwarded by    Chief Detective Inspector.

Sir,
    An auction as above, was held in the French room Central Police
Station compound this afternoon. The articles sold included four
kongs of damaged bomb cases (part or the whole of which may have
been seized by the French Police from time to time). Sold to
Ah Kung (阿根 ), 355 Tsipoo Road.
    4 boxes of khaki masks.
    1 basket of India rubber bars.
    These masks are apparently made to be worn as respirators
when assailed by poison gas. Bought by Yui Da (餘大), 600
Peking Road.
    Five cases of glass jars encased in perforated tin, about
seven inches high. These are apparently for holding a liquid
which would generate poison gas when broken and exposed to the
air. Bought by Ah Kung (阿根), and Yui Da (餘大) as above.

                                    Your obedient servant,
                                    WB newton.
                                    Detective Sub-Inspector.

Chief Detective Inspector.

日期 16. 9. 18                           1916 年 9 月 15 日。

关于已故陈其美或其革命党其他成员财产拍卖的报告。

由副督察布鲁斯特（D.S.I. Brewster）撰写。    由首席侦探督察转呈。

先生：
    上述拍卖于今日下午在中央巡捕房大院内的法式房间举行。拍品包括四箱破损的炸弹壳（其中部分或全部可能系法国警察不时查获）。卖予芝浦路 355 号的阿根（Ah Kung）。
    4 盒卡其色面具。
    1 篮印度橡胶条。
    这些面具显然是为了在遭受毒气攻击时作为呼吸器佩戴而制作的。由北京路 600 号的餘大（Yui Da）购得。
    五箱装在穿孔锡罐中的玻璃罐，高约七英寸。这些显然是用于盛装一种液体，该液体在破碎并暴露于空气中时会产生毒气。由上述阿根（Ah Kung）和餘大（Yui Da）购得。

                                    您顺从的仆人，
                                    W.B. 牛顿。
                                    副侦探督察。

首席侦探督察。
